name.value: Stotan Falls Wood Products and Farm

description.value: Stotan Falls Wood Products and Farm is a small regenerative farm and forestry operation outside Courtenay on Duncan Bay Mainline, focused on putting carbon back into the soil. The farm sells direct from a farm stand, offering seasonal produce including garlic, sunchokes, and berries, as well as native and ornamental trees grown on site. It accepts Bitcoin and Lightning network payments, which is unusual for a rural farm stand.
